visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright airport terminal, a woman wearing a beige long coat, cap, and jeans pushes a luggage cart loaded with several suitcases. She appears flustered, holding a boarding pass and checking the flight information screens. A young boy in a grey jacket stands nearby eating a chocolate snack. (2) The scene shifts to a snowy mountain landscape at a ski resort. The woman, now in a white ski suit and helmet, falls backwards into the deep snow with a playful expression. Children and other skiers are seen gliding down the slopes in the background. (3) A male ski instructor in a red uniform smiles and gives a thumbs-up to the camera. The setting shows a professional ski school area with blue and orange safety markers on the snow. The lighting is bright and natural daylight. (4) Inside a buffet-style restaurant, close-up shots show various dishes: sliced duck, fresh vegetables, pastas, and desserts. The woman is seen eating a snack while the boy happily eats a bowl of noodles in a well-lit dining hall with large windows. (5) Back on the snowy slopes, the woman skis towards the camera, performing a joyful pose with one arm raised. The background shows a multi-story lodge and a pine forest under an overcast winter sky.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 1 main child, several instructors and other guests in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman in her 30s with long brown hair, often wearing a beige coat or a white ski suit. A young boy around 7-9 years old in casual winter wear.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions from a bustling airport terminal with digital screens to a vast, snow-covered ski resort with lodges and pine trees, and an indoor high-end buffet area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female narration starts immediately, speaking rapidly with a frantic and stressed tone. A syncopated electronic drum beat begins, paired with a bright synth melody. Short, sharp 'scuff' sounds of luggage wheels on tile are audible. (2) A synthetic 'whoosh' transition leads into a more energetic and joyful vocal delivery. The music becomes more driving. A soft 'poof' sound occurs as the narrator mentions falling into snow, followed by an enthusiastic rising pitch contour. (3) Subtle 'clinking' sounds of silverware and dishes appear during the food segment. A distinct 'slurp' sound effect is heard as the child eats noodles, timed with the upbeat BGM. (4) The final phase features a clear, authoritative promotional tone with high vocal dominance. A 'ding' sound effect highlights the text discount on screen. The music reaches its peak energy before a sharp, percussive final beat and clean fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Pain points -> Solution -> Feature Breakdown -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the all-inclusive winter holiday packages at Club Med Tomamu by contrasting the stress of traditional family travel with the ease and luxury of a resort that provides child care, professional ski lessons, and unlimited dining.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of resort name, logo, features, and promotional pricing with a clear call to action.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a 'problem-solution' format common in social media advertising to engage parents. The transition from grayscale or muted 'airport stress' to 'resort joy' is highly effective for visual impact.
